I replied to Hollis in our DM: Gate 40 is now his dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups.

I didn't save it to my persistent memory, because that memory is shared across every conversation, including other members' ones. That would break the rule against carrying what someone tells me in a DM into other conversations. I told Hollis this and said the DM itself is the record, so I can look it up there whenever he asks. I took no other action.
